oracle: Generator state expectations cross-checked by separate stdlib tokenize traversal and compile-only syntax check of actual Git blobs; no CAMI index/validator calls in oracle.
checks: all available states equal oracle support
all_validate and original_incomplete select every claim
reporting: Report every seed and event, counts, all mismatches and descriptive validation savings. No population inference, speedup claim, real labels, held-out evaluation or tuning after observed results.
failure_policy: Preserve failed artifacts, report discrepancies, fix demonstrated implementation or oracle defects with a recorded amendment, rerun in a new directory. Never omit failed seeds.
